audit.why: All seven rows read Galio in the full layer, the content layer and packet.levelChart — no cross-layer disagreement to fix here. Spikes: your level 3 rotation, level 6 (Hero's Entrance against a champion whose only mobility is a 575-unit there-and-back blink), and first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The one mechanic that decides the matchup was never written down: Sleepy Trouble Bubble reduces the sleeping target's Magic Resist and doubles the first source of damage that wakes them. The page's whole identity is 'trade behind MR', and this ability specifically defeats that.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.' 18/17/16/15/14 at 800 range.
audit.corrected: TL;DR, enemyWin, cooldowns, trading and the first-item spike all now say the sleep cuts your MR and doubles the waking hit, so the answer is body-blocking the bubble rather than stacking resistances.

audit.why: Bubble is 18s at rank 1 down to 14s, Portal Jump 11/8/5 — a whiffed bubble is 18 seconds of a Zoe who cannot kill you.
audit.corrected: Both written in with Shield of Durand's 18s.

notes: The lint's ten misgendered fields were all real and are fixed, including the two report entries it flagged (report[0].t and report[3].t) — those are the only two report rewrites in this proposal. The substantive finding: Sleepy Trouble Bubble reduces the sleeping target's Magic Resist and doubles the first damage that breaks the sleep, which is exactly the mechanic that defeats this page's 'trade behind MR' identity, and it appeared nowhere on the page. Also corrected a second instance of the repo-wide error crediting Winds of War with a knockup — Galio's knockup is Justice Punch. Level chart is consistent across both layers and the packet, so it was left alone. Worth a second look: the chart gives Galio all seven rows at 7-8/10 ratings while the actual win rate is 50.09% over 1162 games. I did not flip anything on that basis alone, since the kit genuinely favours Galio in lane, but a 4/10 difficulty with a dead-even win rate is a tension somebody should decide deliberately.
